title: How agents publish independent data commits — data examples and schemas

cards.name: Committed data snapshot
cards.description: The full commit SHA selects inputs from the private remote. Uncommitted live edits are absent.
fields: tree: tracked private files at that commit
uses: Private Git remote -> Agent-owned experiment checkout: Clone committed snapshot [clone]

cards.name: Owned experiment files
cards.description: Only explicitly named run directories are copied. Source and destination files must have equal SHA-256 hashes.
uses: Shared production checkout -> Agent-owned experiment checkout: Copy explicitly owned outputs with hash checks [preserve]

cards.name: Experiment branch commit
cards.description: The owner stages named run files, commits them, and pushes an owned branch to the same private remote.
fields: commit: private Git commit containing owned run files
uses: Agent-owned experiment checkout -> Private Git remote: Owner commits and pushes an owned branch [push]
